BACKGROUND: The server now returns an `attempt_bundle` object (when FREYTAG_EXPOSE_PROMPT=1) on /api/v1/turn: on success in the JSON payload, and on a 409 rejection in the JSON body beside the unchanged string `detail`. Schema (storygame/runtime/attempt_bundle.py, read it): schema_version 1, identity, pre_state, command, stages[{kind,request,reply,error}], selected_reveal, committed_delta{fact_predicates,scene_from,scene_to}, cue_stage, transition_cause in none|earned|forced|timer, outcome in committed|rejected|game_break|operational_failure, rejection, operational_failure. Today frontend/e2e/blind-player.js keeps only a single prompt per turn (turnRecord().prompt, collectPrompts, promptsCategory) and analyseRun derives exit_cause by comparing transition_turn with handoff_after_turns ('play' if earlier else 'timer'), which mislabels a late earned exit as timer.

DO:
1. helpers.js submitTurn: when the response is not ok, keep throwing the same message text, but attach the parsed body to the thrown error as `error.payload` (and status as `error.status`). Nothing else changes.
2. blind-player.js: turnRecord carries `attempt_bundle: payload.attempt_bundle || null` beside the existing fields; the old `prompt` slot and collectPrompts/promptsCategory stay exactly as they are and old captures without a bundle stay readable. Add an exported `collectBundles(turns)` returning [{turn, attempt_bundle}] for turns that have a bundle (a rejected turn also has one). turnLog gains `transition_cause` and `outcome` from the bundle (null when absent).
3. analyseRun: exit_cause comes from the bundle of the committed transition turn when it has one: map earned->'play', forced->'forced', timer->'timer'; if there is no bundle fall back to the old turn-count rule unchanged (keep 'unknown' behaviour). Add fields `exit_transition_cause` (the raw cause or null) and `bundle_rejected_turns` (count of rejected turns that carry a bundle). aggregate and formatMarkdown: add `forced_exit_rate` beside play/timer rates and mention forced exits in the markdown Exits line; keep existing keys and wording otherwise.
4. blind-player.spec.js: in the 409 catch branch read `error.payload?.attempt_bundle` into the rejected turn record (attempt_bundle field; keep prompt null). Write bundles to a third category report `blind-player-bundles` (derive the name like promptsCategory does with a new exported `bundlesCategory(category)`: 'blind-player' -> 'blind-player-bundles', 'blind-player-rN' -> 'blind-player-bundles-rN'), shaped like the prompt report but with `bundles` per scene. Do not remove or change the prompts report. Leave attempt bundles out of the main report like prompts.
5. Update blind-player.test.js (existing deepEqual on turnRecord legitimately gains a key; update it) and add node tests: turnRecord/collectBundles incl. a rejected-turn bundle; analyseRun late earned exit (transition turn >= handoff_after_turns with bundle cause 'earned') gives exit_cause 'play' and exit_transition_cause 'earned'; forced and timer bundles; no-bundle fallback still gives old results; bundlesCategory; aggregate forced_exit_rate; helpers error.payload is not unit-testable without Playwright so skip it but state that in notes. merge-blind-player.js/test: only change if the new category or fields break it (check how it merges replicate reports; keep it working with the bundles category if it enumerates categories).
Style: match the surrounding JS.

HOW TO RUN (from the cwd): cd frontend && node --test src/*.test.js e2e/*.test.js . Ruff is not relevant to JS. Reply with files changed.
